summary: Tested BM (Boletim de Medição) feature - timesheet selection and date filtering. Backend: 13/13 tests passed. Frontend: UI loads correctly but Playwright automation has issues with React Native Web TouchableOpacity components.

integration_issues.issue: React Native Web TouchableOpacity components don't respond to standard Playwright click events. Login button click doesn't trigger the onPress handler.
integration_issues.note: This is a known limitation of Playwright with React Native Web, not a bug in the app

critical_code_review_comments: Backend BM endpoints correctly implemented: GET /api/bm/timesheets/{os_id} returns timesheet list with id, date_range, employees, entries_count, supervisor_name
POST /api/bm/calculate/{os_id} correctly accepts timesheet_ids, data_inicio, data_fim in request body
Night shift rates correctly calculated at +20% over day rates
Frontend boletim-medicao.tsx has proper data-testid attributes for all interactive elements
Frontend correctly uses bmAPI.getTimesheets() and bmAPI.calculate() with POST method

success_rate.frontend: UI verified via screenshots - BM page loads, tabs work, 'Novo Boletim' button visible

context_for_next_testing_agent: BM feature backend fully tested and working. All 13 pytest tests pass. Frontend UI loads correctly. Playwright has issues with React Native Web TouchableOpacity - use manual testing or consider adding web-specific click handlers.

api_verification.GET /api/bm/timesheets/{os_id}: Working - returns list of timesheets for OS
